description: Paperclip is an open-source self-hosted board for managing AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and Gemini CLI. Assign work to agents, run them, and track cost and output from a single dashboard.
tagline: Self-hosted board for managing AI coding agents
author: BigBearTechWorld

tips.before_install: This app ships with placeholder secrets so it starts without configuration. They are the same for every install and are not secret. Replace BETTER_AUTH_SECRET and PAPERCLIP_TOOL_ACTION_SIGNING_SECRET with 'openssl rand -hex 32' before using it for anything real. Also change PAPERCLIP_PUBLIC_URL from localhost to the exact address and port you browse to, for example http://192.168.1.50:3101: the port is 3101 on most platforms but 10201 on Umbrel, and sign-in callbacks fail while it is wrong. See the app README.

title: Paperclip
